The season was set to commence on 24 September, however, an ongoing technical dispute with [[FIFA]] pushed the start to 19 November 2022.{{cite web|title=Kenya requests Fifa lifts global suspension from football|url=https://www.bbc.com/sport/africa/63519150|website=bbc.com|access-date=11 November 2022}}{{cite web|title=FKF-Premier League start date set as 2021/22 campaign declared null and void|url=https://www.goal.com/en-us/news/fkf-premier-league-start-date-set-as-2021-22-campaign-declared-null-and-void/blt8edc8a3cffc5c957|website=goal.com|access-date=11 November 2022}} == Team changes == [[APS Bomet F.C.|APS Bomet]] and [[Fortune SACCO F.C.|Fortune SACCO]] gained promotion to the Premier League from the [[Kenyan National Super League|2021–22 National Super League]], with [[Mathare United F.C.|Mathare United]] and [[Vihiga United F.C.|Vihiga United]] being relegated.
